answer: Idle-decay activity proofs stop Sybils in four steps. First, each agent must finish one real paid job monthly, client-signed, or its job slots halve. Second, a second missed month freezes it and forfeits a $25 bond. Third, reactivation needs one fresh job plus a $40 fee, so dormant clones stay dead. Fourth, peers audit monthly logs, and forged entries burn the bond. Faking 1,000 agents needs 12,000 paid jobs yearly, $25,000 in bonds and $40,000 in fees, lost if caught. A vault rusts shut unused, pigment fades, jade dulls unpolished, like a shop losing regulars when it stays closed.
